ceu: ✦ The trine between Jupiter and Saturn

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Teach someone something you know well.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Review debts, loans or shared accounts calmly.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.
